scope: All six TASKS.md contracts; utilities.py only, with local self-checks allowed by plan
design_assessment: Six independent functions can be repaired without public signature changes or external dependencies.

Standard-library copying, heap-based ready-node ordering, csv.reader logical records, instance-owned cache entries, and staged dictionary balance updates provide feasible implementations of the stated contracts.
TASKS.md supplies observable acceptance for ordering, invalid inputs, generators, alias isolation, expiration equality, explicit empty CSV cells, and atomic input preservation.
acceptance_focus: paginate offset+limit semantics and generator input; invalid offsets and limits
deep_merge nested override behavior and bidirectional mutation isolation for lists and dictionaries
topological_order prerequisite-only nodes, duplicate edges, lexical ready-node selection, cycles
parse_csv_rows normalized headers, quoted newlines, physical blank rows versus explicit empty fields, exact row widths
ExpiringCache instance isolation, invalid ttl preserving old entry, falsey values, expiration equality and deletion
apply_transfers ordered funds checks, bool rejection, self-transfers, generator input, no input mutation after late failure
